summary: Tested new AI Chat and File Upload features. Backend: 10/11 tests pass (90.9%). File upload/download to GridFS works. AI Chat non-streaming works. Transcript analysis works. CRITICAL BUG: AI Chat streaming endpoint fails - 'LlmChat' object has no attribute 'stream_message'. Frontend: AI widget opens and shows 'Online' status with welcome message.

critical.issue: Streaming fails with error: 'LlmChat' object has no attribute 'stream_message'. The emergentintegrations.llm.openai.LlmChat class does not have a stream_message method.
critical.rca: The code at line 1738 in server.py calls 'chat.stream_message()' but the LlmChat class from emergentintegrations only has: get_messages, send_message, send_message_multimodal_response, with_model, with_params

integration_issues.issue: When streaming fails, the chat widget shows error in console but user doesn't see clear error message. The non-streaming fallback should be considered.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Backend streaming endpoint /api/ai/chat/stream needs to use a different approach since LlmChat doesn't have stream_message method. Options: (1) Remove streaming and use non-streaming only, (2) Find alternative streaming method in emergentintegrations library, (3) Implement custom streaming with OpenAI SDK directly
Frontend munalAIChatService.js uses sendMessageStream which calls the broken streaming endpoint - should fallback to sendMessage on error or implement retry logic
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1738: chat.stream_message() method doesn't exist - needs fix or alternative
fileService.js correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for API calls
insightsService.js correctly calls /api/transcripts/analyze with proper fallback
MunalAIChatContainer.jsx sets isApiKeyValid=true by default which is correct since backend handles the key

context_for_next_testing_agent: File upload (POST /api/chat/files/upload) and download (GET /api/chat/files/{file_id}) work correctly with GridFS. AI Chat non-streaming (POST /api/ai/chat) works. Transcript analysis (POST /api/transcripts/analyze) works. STREAMING IS BROKEN - the emergentintegrations LlmChat class doesn't have stream_message method. Frontend AI widget displays but can't send messages due to streaming dependency.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The backend code at server.py line ~1738 calls 'chat.stream_message(UserMessage(text=last_msg.content))' but the LlmChat class from emergentintegrations.llm.openai doesn't have a stream_message method. Available methods are: get_messages, send_message, send_message_multimodal_response, with_model, with_params
reproduction_steps: 1. Call POST /api/ai/chat/stream with valid message payload
2. Backend tries to call chat.stream_message() which doesn't exist
3. Returns error: 'LlmChat' object has no attribute 'stream_message'
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Either remove streaming functionality and use non-streaming API only, or find an alternative streaming approach in the emergentintegrations library, or implement streaming directly with OpenAI SDK
